caption:
UK visit visas are digital now. There is no sticker in your passport, and that catches people out at the gate.

Your permission lives in an online account linked to your passport. Nothing physical to show. The airline checks the record.

Two consequences: if your passport details change, that link must be updated, and you need account access while travelling. Always confirm current guidance on gov.uk.
